title: Tetrameter
summary: TETRAM'ETER, noun [Gr. four, and measure.] In ancient poetry, an iambic verse consisting of four feet, found in the comic poets. A verse consisting of four measures or eight feet.

inlines.v: TETRAM'ETER, noun [Gr. four, and measure.] In ancient poetry, an iambic verse consisting of four feet, found in the comic poets. A verse consisting of four measures or eight feet.
